notes:
Lead: product/ops at BillScribe (Kara Patel, Sr PM). Mid-market billing SaaS; heavy Stripe + Zuora integrations. Evaluating Redwood for support agents that can call billing APIs (Stripe/Zuora) and emit structured JSON responses for downstream systems.

POC ask: 1-week hosted POC using streaming + tool-calling to Stripe sandbox and their internal billing microservice. Must demonstrate: streaming token throughput, <=200ms p50 token latency, reliable function/tool calling for charge lookups/refunds, and structured JSON outputs for ticket system ingestion.

Quoted on call: "We need predictable latency — agent must respond quickly while hitting Stripe for live data. If hosted works, will move to Dedicated for capacity/cost predictability."

Security: must meet SOC2, SSO/SAML for staff, audit logs for tool calls, optional KMS integration. Concerned about data residency for EU customers (they have EU customers).

Commercials: asks for 6-month committed pricing for Dedicated if POC passes. Current workaround: hybrid — hosted for new agents, dedicated for high-volume routes. Cost sensitivity medium-high; wants unit token cost comparison + estimated billing API call cost.

Next steps listed in timeline + asked for sample streaming demo with Stripe tool-calls and a JSON schema example for structured outputs.

use_case_summary: BillScribe wants an agent-based support assistant for subscription/billing workflows. Core flows: find customer by email -> fetch invoices from Stripe/Zuora -> propose refund or subscription change -> emit structured JSON action object for downstream ticket automation. Needs streaming responses for perceived latency, robust tool calling to external billing APIs, structured JSON outputs, and ability to scale to peak support hours.
